shots.title: Z01 · Weighted ACH
shots.caption: Competing hypotheses with weighted evidence: click a cell to cycle consistent / inconsistent / neutral, and click the ×1 on a row to weight that evidence ×2 or ×3 when it is more diagnostic. The score per hypothesis is the weighted inconsistency; the case brief prints it and names the leading hypothesis.

shots.title: Z02 · AI hypotheses
shots.caption: Drafts: the model (or the rules engine when no key is set) proposes competing hypotheses from the whole case, each with the evidence that would discriminate it, including a benign or misattribution option. "Add to the ACH grid" puts them next to your own.

shots.title: Z03 · AI case summary
shots.caption: Executive summary drafted from notes, exhibits, threads and hypotheses, citing exhibit numbers. "Append to case notes" stamps it with the date and the engine that wrote it, so a reviewer can tell a model's words from the analyst's.

shots.title: Z05 · Email ingestion
shots.caption: From a file: the server parses the .eml (decoded headers, Received chain, links, attachments hashed) and proposes an event card for the message plus indicator cards for the sender, the mismatching Reply-To, the first external relay, every link and each attachment's SHA-256 and file name, threaded to the event. PDFs and text files go through entity extraction instead.

shots.title: Z04 · AI takedown draft
shots.caption: Takedown / abuse letter drafted for the recipient you name, listing the case's live indicators defanged, asking for suspension and log preservation. Open it as a page to print or copy it into your ticketing system.

shots.title: Z06 · Quick add
shots.caption: Quick add now explains itself: type ? for every command; an unknown command is refused with a hint instead of silently becoming a note; new kinds f (file name) and host (hostname) join the indicator set, and hash cards are labelled MD5 / SHA-1 / SHA-256 in the brief and letters.

shots.title: Z07 · Timeline by time
shots.caption: Timeline view: cards sharing a date are now stacked in time-of-day order (09:14 above 14:05), and the brief's chronology prints the time column. New cards added from quick add or an import land in a free spot beside the board rather than on a pile in the centre.

shots.title: Z08 · Push to MISP / TheHive / Jira
shots.caption: Share: with MISP, TheHive or Jira configured on the server, one click pushes the case: a MISP event with typed attributes (to_ids for confirmed indicators), a TheHive alert with observables and TLP, or a Jira issue. The result links back, a link card lands in the inbox and the case log records it. Falsified indicators are never sent.

shots.title: Z09 · STIX feed
shots.caption: STIX feeds (admins): a feed is a token URL scoped by maximum TLP and, if you like, confirmed indicators only. A TIP imports stix.json, a SIEM takes indicators.csv, a firewall pulls indicators.txt. The token is shown once; remove the feed to revoke it. Add an https webhook and an interval to push the bundle on a schedule.

shots.title: Z10 · Brief with weighted ACH
shots.caption: The case brief now ranks the hypotheses by weighted inconsistency and names the leading one, labels hash indicators by algorithm, and prints the time of day in the timeline table.
